notes.title: Update Notes For: January 14
notes.notes:
1.【Optimization】Greatly increased the base damage of 【Lightning Fist】 and 【Flame Cannon】, as well as the base damage of heavy attacks.
2.【Optimization】Upgraded the attack enhancement for heavy cards; the minimum value for normal quality cards increased to 10%, while red cards increased to 25%.
3.【Optimization】Enhanced the key card abilities for the light attack builds of 【Flame Cannon】 and 【Lightning Fist】.
4.【Important】Temporarily removed the 【Cursed Challenge】; the 【Cursed Series】 equipment can now be purchased in treasure chests and shops.
5.【Optimization】Greatly increased the base damage of all 【Sub-Weapons】.
6.【Important】Upgrades and advancements have been changed to use coins for 【refreshing】.
7.【Optimization】Character leveling is now faster.
8.【Fix】Resolved the issue where certain advanced cards were not functioning.
9.【Fix】Rewrote the resource loading method, thoroughly addressing the crash issue! (Hopefully)
10.【Fix】Resolved the issue where the Vortex Cloak had no selectable cards.
Summary: This version should provide a smoother gameplay experience!
